summary: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
briefing: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

summary: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
briefing: Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.

summary: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report

summary: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes

summary: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations

briefing: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.
